decision_rules: A novelty statement must identify the exact candidate, scope and comparison axis.
Similarity in one axis cannot establish identity or novelty in another axis.
Search coverage, indexing gaps, language limits, paywalls, date cutoffs and false-negative risks must be recorded.
No external search result, absence claim or originality acceptance is created by this preparation package.
Final originality disposition remains separate from physical, engineering, VVUQ and net-output evidence.
